scope: Bounded primary-source update; no model experiments or claims of exhaustive review

papers.title: ReFit: Recurrent Fitting Network for 3D Human Recovery
papers.excerpt: Each keypoint is only reprojected to one channel
papers.summary: ReFit learns keypoint-specific image feature channels, queries neighborhoods by mesh projection, concatenates ordered feedback, and uses separate recurrent update streams for body parameters. Its introduction explicitly motivates anatomically localized responses to alignment error.
papers.relevance: Closest established mechanism. C10 cannot claim first identity-preserving geometric feedback or first disentangled recurrent body updates.
papers.unknown: No same-input C10 comparison; exact attention alternative is different.

papers.title: PyMAF-X: Towards Well-aligned Full-body Model Regression from Monocular Images
papers.loc: Section III-A2, spatial alignment attention; lines 221–228
papers.excerpt: fuse the information from both grid and mesh-aligned features
papers.summary: Mesh projections select local evidence from a feature pyramid; spatial alignment self-attention mixes grid and mesh-aligned features. Full-body extension integrates part-specific regressors with wrist correction.
papers.relevance: Local projected sampling and attention fusion are inherited prior art, not the C10 delta.
papers.unknown: Different feedback token semantics and full-body integration; no equal-input evaluation.

papers.title: WHAM: Reconstructing World-grounded Humans with Accurate 3D Motion
papers.authors: Soyong Shin; Juyong Kim; Eni Halilaj; Michael J. Black
papers.excerpt: fuses this with video features, integrating motion context and visual information
papers.summary: Motion-capture-trained lifting of 2D keypoint sequences is fused with video appearance; camera angular velocity and contact-aware trajectory refinement support world coordinates.
papers.relevance: Strong temporal/keypoint fusion reference; input detector and motion priors differ from C10.
papers.unknown: World metrics are not C10 camera-space metrics; temporal smoothing and test conventions require alignment.

papers.title: TRAM: Global Trajectory and Motion of 3D Humans from in-the-wild Videos
papers.authors: Yufu Wang; Ziyun Wang; Lingjie Liu; Kostas Daniilidis
papers.excerpt: We keep the ViT-Huge backbone frozen
papers.summary: TRAM separates scene-camera recovery from local human motion. VIMO adds temporal transformers in image-patch and motion domains on frozen HMR2 features while finetuning the decoder.
papers.relevance: Closest backbone/temporal adaptation reference; frozen HMR2 plus temporal attention alone does not distinguish C10.
papers.unknown: VIMO is a component of TRAM here, not an independently counted paper.

papers.title: PromptHMR: Promptable Human Mesh Recovery
papers.authors: Yufu Wang; Yu Sun; Priyanka Patel; Kostas Daniilidis; Michael J. Black; Muhammed Kocabas
papers.excerpt: a decoder-only temporal transformer module with twelve attention blocks
papers.summary: Full-image promptable body recovery uses spatial and semantic prompts. Video extension temporally processes per-subject SMPL-X/depth decoder tokens and uses camera recovery for world trajectories.
papers.relevance: Input/context and video-token processing comparator, not the same internal feedback intervention.
papers.unknown: Requires distinguishing full-image versus crop, SMPL-X conversion, prompt mode and camera/world metrics.

papers.title: SAM 3D Body: Robust Full-Body Human Mesh Recovery
papers.excerpt: a MHR mesh is mapped to the SMPL mesh format
papers.summary: Promptable single-image full-body recovery uses MHR, decoupling skeletal structure and surface shape, with keypoint/mask conditioning and a diverse annotation/data engine. SMPL benchmark evaluation explicitly maps MHR meshes.
papers.relevance: Strong accuracy/data/representation comparator; source of prior geometry-teacher route, not proof that that route succeeded.
papers.unknown: MHR-to-SMPL mapping/version, test crop, detector/prompt mode and backbone must be frozen before comparable evaluation.

papers.title: World-Grounded Human Motion Recovery via Gravity-View Coordinates
papers.excerpt: defined by the world gravity and the camera view direction
papers.summary: Predicts in gravity-view coordinates then maps poses into world space using camera rotations, avoiding an autoregressive global trajectory formulation.
papers.relevance: World representation and camera-space benchmark comparator; does not establish C10 novelty in local feedback.
papers.unknown: Full latest journal-extension text not read; no inference that camera input or coordinates match C10.

papers.title: CameraHMR: Aligning People with Perspective
papers.summary: Improves pseudo labels using estimated intrinsics, full perspective fitting and dense surface keypoints, and includes camera parameters in an HMR2-based model.
papers.relevance: Strong camera/annotation comparator; motivates checking crop and camera mismatches before attributing gains to architecture.
papers.unknown: No same-input rerun; training/pseudo-label differences remain.

papers.title: OnlineHMR: Video-based Online World-Grounded Human Mesh Recovery
papers.summary: Uses causal cached attention, sliding-window training and incremental human-centric SLAM for online recovery, with explicit causality and efficiency criteria.
papers.relevance: Temporal comparison must label C10 offline; cached inference and latency cannot be equated to offline fixed windows.
papers.unknown: Full paper methods not read; no numerical latency adopted.

papers.title: PostoMETRO: Pose Token Enhanced Mesh Transformer for Robust 3D Human Mesh Recovery
papers.authors: Wendi Yang; Zihang Jiang; Shang Zhao; S. Kevin Zhou
papers.loc: Abstract lines 16–19; CVF paper abstract located
papers.excerpt: queried by vertex and joint tokens
papers.summary: Encodes 2D pose into compact tokens, combines them with image tokens, and lets vertex/joint queries decode 3D geometry for robustness to occlusion.
papers.relevance: Direct prior for pose-evidence tokens queried by joints; C10 delta must name continuous inherited residuals, anatomical bias and recurrent insertion.
papers.unknown: Abstract does not establish equivalence to C10's 17-to-24 routed feedback.

papers.title: MoPO: Incorporating Motion Prior for Occluded Human Mesh Recovery
papers.authors: Tao Tang; Hong Liu; Xinshun Wang; Wanruo Zhang
papers.excerpt: predicting the most plausible joint positions based on history poses
papers.summary: Detects spatial-temporal visibility, predicts missing joints from motion history, fuses completed pose with image features, and refines pose via inverse kinematics.
papers.relevance: Recent visibility-aware motion/refinement prior; relevant to any proposed detector/IK extension, which C10 currently disables.
papers.unknown: Detailed architecture, experiments and venue not read/verified.

papers.title: DETRAM: End-to-end DEtection, Tracking and Recovery of HumAn Meshes
papers.authors: Chunggi Lee; Seonwook Park; Wanhua Li; Umar Iqbal; Hanspeter Pfister
papers.excerpt: identity-consistent set of learnable query embeddings that persist across frames
papers.summary: Unifies multi-person detection, tracking, reconstruction and prompt-directed identity following using persistent learned queries.
papers.relevance: Recent identity-token work, but identities concern people/tracks rather than C10 landmark-to-joint routing.
papers.unknown: No claim of identical anatomical feedback; full methods not read.

papers.title: FactorizedHMR: A Hybrid Framework for Video Human Mesh Recovery
papers.venue: NeurIPS 2026 acceptance stated on author arXiv record; proceedings not separately checked
papers.summary: Separates a stable deterministic torso/root estimate from flow-matching completion of uncertain distal articulation, with geometry supervision and feature-aware guidance.
papers.relevance: Newer version of a source already in DESIGN_ZH; matters for uncertainty/part-aware claims but is not C10's deterministic route.
papers.unknown: No authorization inferred to resume old probabilistic or teacher route; full v4 paper not read.

papers.title: STAF: 3D Human Mesh Recovery from Video with Spatio-Temporal Alignment Fusion
papers.authors: Wei Yao; Hongwen Zhang; Yunlian Sun; Jinhui Tang

papers.summary: Combines attention-based temporal coherence fusion, projected local spatial features, adjacent spatial alignment fusion, and sequence-level pooling.
papers.relevance: Direct missing spatial-temporal alignment neighbor; generic local-plus-temporal fusion is not a new C10 contribution.
